title: Null Coalescing and Conditional Operators
learning_outcomes: Explain what null coalescing and conditional operators contributes to a PHP application.
Apply at least one of these concepts in a small example: null coalescing.
Check one edge case and explain how to diagnose unexpected behavior.

content.intro: Operators combine values into expressions. Parentheses, precedence, strict comparisons, and deliberate fallback behavior help prevent expressions that compile but communicate the wrong intent. In this lesson, focus on null coalescing; then compare it with null coalescing assignment. Use the example to predict a result before checking it, and record one case where the behavior may differ.
content.why_it_matters: You will use null coalescing and conditional operators when building readable, testable PHP programs. Its practical value is knowing which rule applies, what result to expect, and how to handle failure or unexpected input.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Operators combine values into expressions. Parentheses, precedence, strict comparisons, and deliberate fallback behavior help prevent expressions that compile but communicate the wrong intent. For null coalescing and conditional operators, begin with null coalescing. Also distinguish null coalescing assignment; ternary expressions; choosing clear fallback logic. Identify the input, the rule applied, and the observable output or side effect; then check the relevant official reference when a version or edge-case detail matters.

common_mistakes.problem: Copying a pattern without understanding its inputs and output.
common_mistakes.why: Small environment or type differences can change behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Trace one example by hand, name expected outputs, and consult version-matched official docs.

common_mistakes.problem: Ignoring empty, invalid, or boundary input.
common_mistakes.why: Real data rarely matches only the simplest example.
common_mistakes.fix: Add a deliberate edge-case check before relying on the result.

common_mistakes.problem: Making several changes at once while debugging.
common_mistakes.why: It becomes difficult to identify which change caused the behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Reduce the issue to one small reproducible case, change one cause, and retest.
